facts.fact: The World Bank's ISR for the ASTRE programme (P178835) records that as at 30 September 2024 the eID was soft-launched on 27 November 2023, the RSPM social registry software was 75% complete, and the data exchange platform between eID, RSPM, BOMS and other administrative systems was 'Not in place', with a target of December 2026.
facts.system: Interoperable social information system (SIIS) and data exchange platform

facts.fact: The same report records a multi-programme, multi-provider payments platform with an eID-to-mobile-money mapper (Payments Bridge, to be maintained by ANID) as a programme target for December 2025, with FSB and Novissi still running separate systems with mobile money payment capabilities as at 30 September 2024.
facts.system: Payments Bridge and multi-program payments platform

systems.system: Registre Social des Personnes et des Menages (RSPM)
Payments Bridge and multi-program payments platform
